cohort: 60 women undergoing elective lower segment cesarean section with singleton pregnancy were recruited.
finding: IVCCI is a reliable predictor of the incidence of hypotension following repair of the uterus when exteriorized during elective lower segment cesarean section.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken before spinal anesthesia, 15 mins after spinal anesthesia, after uterine repair, and after the end of surgery.
